primary_datasets.label: MMLU-Pro
primary_datasets.primary_metric: Task accuracy under a pinned evaluator
primary_datasets.primary_metric_zh: 固定评分器下的任务准确率
primary_datasets.version_policy: Freeze the exact dataset revision and evaluator before publishing task-quality scores.
primary_datasets.note: Serving B0 evidence exists, but it is not a task-accuracy result.
primary_datasets.note_zh: 已有服务侧 B0 证据，但不能将其当作任务准确率结果。

primary_datasets.label: HLE-Verified
primary_datasets.primary_metric: Accuracy under the pinned HLE-Verified evaluator
primary_datasets.primary_metric_zh: 固定 HLE-Verified 评分器下的准确率
primary_datasets.version_policy: Freeze the dataset revision and explicitly choose the full verified set or a named verified-gold subset.
primary_datasets.note: No measured result is admitted until the evaluated subset and grader are frozen.
primary_datasets.note_zh: 在明确评测子集并冻结评分器之前，不接纳实测结果。

primary_datasets.label: SWE-bench-Pro
primary_datasets.primary_metric: Resolved task rate in isolated regrading
primary_datasets.primary_metric_zh: 隔离复判下的任务解决率
primary_datasets.version_policy: Freeze the validated release, task IDs, Harbor environment, agent scaffold, budget, and regrading protocol.
primary_datasets.note: Agent execution and fresh-sandbox regrading are part of the measurement contract.
primary_datasets.note_zh: 智能体执行与全新沙箱复判均属于测量合同。

primary_datasets.label: FrontierScience
primary_datasets.primary_metric_zh: 分赛道准确率或量表评分
primary_datasets.version_policy: Freeze the dataset revision and report Olympiad and Research tracks separately with their pinned graders.
primary_datasets.note: The two tracks use different answer and scoring contracts and must not be pooled silently.
primary_datasets.note_zh: 两个赛道的答案与评分合同不同，不得静默合并。

primary_datasets.label: Terminal-Bench 2.1
primary_datasets.version_policy: Pin the 2.1 task release, Harbor environment, agent scaffold, tool policy, and budget.
primary_datasets.note: Task resolution is primary; token throughput is supporting telemetry only.
primary_datasets.note_zh: 任务解决率是主指标，token 吞吐仅作为辅助遥测。

supplementary_material.rule: Every registered or planned dataset outside the five primary datasets is supplementary material.
supplementary_material.rule_zh: 除五个主评测集外，所有已注册或已规划的数据集均归入补充材料。
supplementary_material.publication_rule: Preserve measured evidence and configuration-specific scenarios; never turn a planning entry into an empty measured cell.
supplementary_material.publication_rule_zh: 保留所有实测证据及其配置场景；不得把规划项转换成空白实测单元格。
